Use this workflow only when the user explicitly asks for the full OpenSpec + Superpowers path or explicitly invokes this command.

Required order:

1. Explore context.
2. Clarify one question at a time.
3. Present 2-3 approaches and recommend one.
4. Write and confirm a design in `docs/superpowers/specs/`.
5. Complete OpenSpec `proposal.md`, `design.md`, `specs/.../spec.md`, and `tasks.md`.
6. Write the implementation plan in `docs/superpowers/plans/`.
7. Implement with failing test first.
8. Run fresh verification before reporting success.
